jurisdiction.authorityName: Bastrop County Development Services, Environmental & Sanitation, On-Site Sewage Facilities

sourceReference: DRAFT profile, sources read 2026-10-06, from Bastrop County Development Services' OSSF page, fee page, aerobic affidavit (2019-02-12) and OSSF application (rev. 2024-06-20), 30 TAC 285.7 and TCEQ's OSSF maintenance page. The county's OSSF Order is an unreadable scan. Bastrop County publishes no way to submit maintenance reports. See docs/jurisdictions/tx-bastrop-county.md.

requirementEffective.basis: Bastrop County's OSSF Order (TCEQAppdOSSFOrder.pdf) is a scan with no readable text, so its dates are unknown. Aerowise applies the ruleset from 2026-10-06, the day it was written.

sources.title: Bastrop County Development Services: On-Site Sewage Facilities
sources.note: 'A mandatory two year initial maintenance contract with a Licensed Maintenance Provider is required with the installation of a new aerobic OSSF system.' Homeowners may self-maintain after that with approved training. Emergency repairs reported within 72 hours. (512) 581-7176, 211 Jackson Street, Bastrop. Nothing on where maintenance reports go. Read through a page summarizer.

sources.title: Bastrop County On-Site Sewage Facilities Order
sources.note: Could not be read: a scan with no text layer (two attempts).

sources.title: Bastrop County Development Services: Application Fees
sources.note: 'Maintenance Contract Late Fee $100'; 'OSSF Renewal Fee' $20 residential and commercial. What the renewal fee covers and when the late fee applies isn't stated. Read through a page summarizer.

sources.title: Bastrop County Affidavit for Aerobic OSSF Systems (2019-02-12)
sources.note: 'This OSSF shall be covered by a continuous service contract for the first two years.' After that, a single-family owner 'shall either obtain a maintenance contract within 30 days or maintain the system personally (after providing proof of approved training).' Read through a page summarizer.

sources.title: 30 TAC 285.7, Maintenance Requirements (Cornell LII)
sources.note: Last amended effective 2023-07-06. (d)(2): the owner provides a copy of the signed contract to the permitting authority 30 days before the service policy or contract expires. (e): reports to the permitting authority and owner within 14 days after the test; electronic monitoring allows two checks a year instead of four.

sources.title: TCEQ OSSF maintenance requirements
sources.note: Last modified 2026-03-03. Every four months, or six with an electronic monitor that notifies the provider of failures and monitors disinfection; reports within 14 days after the test.

unresolved: Bastrop County publishes no way to submit maintenance inspection reports or renewal contracts. MyGovernmentOnline is published for permit applications only, and the department's general email is not a stated report channel, so inspection filings are held for review and contracts are filed by hand.
The county's OSSF Order is an unreadable scan. Any county-specific frequency, deadline, report contents, lab tests and dates are unknown; Aerowise follows TCEQ's 30 TAC 285.7.
A $100 'Maintenance Contract Late Fee' and a $20 'OSSF Renewal Fee' are published without saying what they cover or when they apply, so no fee is recorded on filings.
The City of Bastrop publishes its own OSSF checklist; whether it, Elgin or Smithville run their own program, and over what area, is not published. Every site needs a reviewed assignment.
Bastrop County publishes no acknowledgment of a received report or contract.

applicability.howToDecide: Bastrop County Development Services permits OSSFs in Bastrop County; the City of Bastrop publishes its own OSSF checklist, and Elgin and Smithville are unknown. Check city limits; if unsure, call the county at (512) 581-7176 (inside the City of Bastrop, city Planning at (512) 322-8840). Record what you checked.

inspectionReports.note: Bastrop County publishes no way to submit maintenance inspection reports.

contracts.note: Bastrop County (read 2026-10-06): a two-year initial contract comes with the permit application. No channel or renewal deadline is published; timing from 30 TAC 285.7(d)(2), 30 days before the current contract expires. Filed by hand.

monitored.note: 30 TAC 285.7(e) and TCEQ's maintenance page: twice a year with an electronic monitor that notifies the provider of failures and monitors disinfection. Bastrop County's order could not be read.

confirmation.note: Bastrop County describes no reply to maintenance reports or contracts.
